lines.en: label springtime16:
scene springsanta1
: Okay, girls! Listen up, because I’m only going to announce this once! And if you miss out, you’re screwed until next Christmas and have to donate your gift to a local charity!
lines.zh: : 好了，姑娘们！听好了，因为这件事我只宣布一次！要是错过了，你们就得等到明年圣诞，还得把礼物捐给当地的慈善机构！

lines.en: : Do we still have to donate our gift if we’re volunteering at a soup kitchen tomorrow?
lines.zh: : 如果我们明天去施粥所当志愿者，礼物还是得捐出去吗？

lines.en: scene springsanta2
: Bitch, you ain’t even in this class.
lines.zh: : 贱人，你根本就不是这个班的。

lines.en: : I know. I just wanted to see if someone wanted to volunteer with me. It’s from 9:00 AM to-
lines.zh: : 我知道。我只是想看看有没有人愿意跟我一起去。时间是上午九点到——

lines.en: : Yeah, we get it. You have a heart of gold and hands of soup.
lines.zh: : 行吧，我们知道了。你有一颗金子般的心，还有一双汤做的手。

lines.en: : I wish I had soup hands. Work would be much easier.
lines.zh: : 我真希望我有一双汤手。工作会轻松多了。

lines.en: : Anyway, before I was blindsided by the world’s sweetest interjection, what I was {i}trying{/i} to say is that it’s getting late, so the time has come to start exchanging this year’s Secret Santa presents.
lines.zh: : 总之，在我被全世界最贴心的插话偷袭之前，我{i}本来想{/i}说的是：时候不早了，该开始交换今年的神秘圣诞老人礼物了。

lines.en: scene springsanta3
: Now, as you may have noticed, the turnout for our party this year is a little...lackluster. So to the few of you who actually showed up, thanks.
lines.zh: : 那么，你们大概也注意到了，今年我们派对的到场人数有点……冷清。所以感谢真正到场的你们这几位。

lines.en: : I know I’m not your {i}normal{/i} teacher, which I imagine is exactly {i}why{/i} Christmas is a bust this year, but I still care about all of you and hope you have, like...a great holiday and shit.
lines.zh: : 我知道我不是你们的{i}正经{/i}老师，我想这大概正是今年圣诞搞砸的{i}原因{/i}，不过我仍然在乎你们所有人，希望你们……过得开心之类的。

lines.en: : To be completely honest, we don’t really have a {i}normal{/i} teacher. But I think I speak for all of us when I say “thank you for being here.” We’re all really happy to have you.
lines.zh: : 老实说，我们也确实没有什么{i}正经{/i}老师。不过我想我代表大家说一句「谢谢你在这里」。我们都很高兴有你在这儿。

lines.en: scene springsanta4
: Except for all the girls who didn’t show up and clearly hate me, you mean. But thanks, Futaba.
lines.zh: : 你是说，除了那些没来、明显恨我的女孩之外吧。不过谢谢你，Futaba。

lines.en: : Anyway, only half the class being here means that a lot of you are going to get snubbed. So I took it upon myself to bring a bunch of random cheap presents so no one leaves empty handed.
lines.zh: : 总之，只有一半的人到场，意味着你们很多人会被漏掉。所以我自作主张带了一堆随机的便宜礼物，好让谁都不会空手而归。

lines.en: : If you wind up getting jipped out of a present or...just want some free shit, help yourself to a box beneath the tree. But please be warned that a lot of it sucks since teachers don’t make much money.
lines.zh: : 如果你们最后被坑了没拿到礼物，或者……只是想拿点免费的东西，就去树下随便拿一盒。不过先提醒一句，很多东西都很烂，因为老师赚得不多。

lines.en: : Sounds to me like somebody’s in the mood to give back to the community! If you’re not doing anything tomorrow-
lines.zh: : 我听起来像是有人很想回馈社会啊！如果你明天没什么事——

lines.en: : I am. Sorry.
lines.zh: : 我有事。抱歉。

lines.en: scene springsanta5
: Looks like it will just be Touka and me, then...
lines.zh: : 那看来就只剩 Touka 和我了……

lines.en: : Guess so. But anyway, feel free to mug the absentees the next time you see them in school.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。不过总之，下次在学校见到那些没来的人，随便抢她们就好。

lines.en: : I had a feeling something like this might happen on account of your {i}actual{/i} teacher being MIA, so I’ve got a list of who owes who you can ask about come tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 我早有预感，因为你{i}真正的{/i}老师失踪了，这种事可能会发生，所以我列了一张谁欠谁的名单，明天你们可以来问。

lines.en: scene black

: But for now, feel free to start walking around and exchanging presents. Once that’s said and done, you’re free to either go home or spend the night. Sleeping bags are in the closet if you need them.
lines.zh: : 不过现在，你们可以开始走动、交换礼物了。等这事办完，你们可以回家，也可以留下来过夜。需要睡袋的话，壁橱里有。

lines.en: : Are you staying here, Imani?
lines.zh: : 你会留在这儿吗，Imani？

lines.en: : Hell nah. I’m going home and drinking myself to sleep. Your sister’s in charge once Secret Santa is over.
lines.zh: : 才不。我要回家喝到睡着。神秘圣诞老人一结束，就由你姐姐负责了。

lines.en: : Soup kitchen duty for everyone! Yay!
lines.zh: : 所有人都要去施粥所！耶！

lines.en: scene springsanta6
: Well, at least you lasted a couple hours before burying your face in another notebook. Good job, Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 嗯，至少你撑了几个小时才又把脸埋进另一本笔记本里。干得好，Nodoka。

lines.en: : Thank you. I haven’t exhibited this level of self control since the night you lost your virginity just a few doors down.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。自从你在几扇门之外失去童贞那晚之后，我就再没表现出过这种程度的自制力。

lines.en: scene springsanta7
: I did not {i}lose my virginity.{/i} And I’m pretty sure Rin didn’t either. But I guess I’m not really clear on the rules when it comes to how that works for lesbian couples.
lines.zh: : 我并没有{i}失去童贞{/i}。而且我敢肯定 Rin 也没有。不过我想，至于这对女同性恋情侣来说规则怎么算，我确实不太清楚。

lines.en: : Now, that is a philosophical question even {i}I{/i} don’t have a concrete answer to. Nonetheless, it was quite difficult not busting down the door and joining in myself.
lines.zh: : 这可是一个连{i}我{/i}都没有确切答案的哲学问题。尽管如此，我当时忍住没撞开门加入进去，还是相当艰难的。

lines.en: : Sure didn’t sound like you were having a tough time from our room.
lines.zh: : 从我们房间听来，你可一点都不像在受煎熬。

lines.en: : Yes, well, {i}you{/i} try having a ten inch penis stuffed inside of you and see if {i}you{/i} manage to remain silent.
lines.zh: : 是吗，那{i}你{/i}试试看被一根十英寸的鸡巴塞在里面，看你能不能保持沉默。

lines.en: scene springsanta8
: Please. I’d very much enjoy that.
lines.zh: : 拜托。我会非常享受的。

lines.en: : {i}Ten?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}十英寸？{/i}

lines.en: : Perhaps even larger. It was quite the spectacle, if I do say so myself. You should ask to see it now that you’re no longer dutifully bound to a girl you never deserved in the first place.
lines.zh: : 也许还更大。恕我直言，那场面相当壮观。既然你已经不再尽职地绑在一个你本来就不配的女孩身边，你该要求看看它。

lines.en: scene springsanta9
: Not saying you’re wrong, but aren’t you supposed to be {i}my{/i} friend?
lines.zh: : 我又没说你错，可你不是应该站在{i}我{/i}这边当朋友吗？

lines.en: : Do friends not admit to one another when they do wrong?
lines.zh: : 朋友之间难道不该在对方做错时指出来吗？

lines.en: : That is a genuine question, by the way. I’m still attempting to understand just what being someone’s friend {i}means{/i} as I am apparently not very good at it. Based on recent history, at least.
lines.zh: : 顺便说一句，这是个真心的问题。我还在试图弄明白当别人的朋友{i}意味着{/i}什么，因为我显然很不擅长。至少从最近的经历来看是这样。

lines.en: : You and Futaba still at odds? Thought things were starting to get better.
lines.zh: : 你和 Futaba 还在闹别扭？我以为情况已经开始好转了。

lines.en: : She’s walking this way now, so feel free to ask her yourself. Unfortunately, I am busy uncovering the secrets of the universe, so I will not be able to assist.
lines.zh: : 她正往这边走过来，你可以自己问她。可惜我正忙着揭开宇宙的奥秘，没法帮忙了。

lines.en: scene springsanta10
: Farewell.
lines.zh: : 告辞。

lines.en: : Wow, you really {i}are{/i} bad at this.
lines.zh: : 哇，你{i}真的{/i}很不擅长这个。

lines.en: : Hey. Sorry to interrupt...but this is for you, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 嘿。抱歉打断一下……不过这是给你的，Otoha。

lines.en: scene springsanta11
: For {i}me?{/i} Why?
lines.zh: : 给{i}我{/i}的？为什么？

lines.en: : Secret Santa. But I’d appreciate it if you could take it from me now so Rin doesn’t see me handing it to you and think that I’m betraying her.
lines.zh: : 神秘圣诞老人。不过我希望你现在就收下，免得 Rin 看见我递给你，以为我在背叛她。

lines.en: scene springsanta12
: Oh, yeah. Sure. But, like...shouldn’t you hate me now? It’s not a bomb in there, is it?
lines.zh: : 哦，好。当然。不过……你现在不是应该恨我吗？里面不是炸弹吧？

lines.en: : I’m not going to {i}hate{/i} you for not following through with a relationship you didn’t believe in.
lines.zh: : 我不会因为你不肯把一段自己并不相信的感情走下去就{i}恨{/i}你。

lines.en: scene springsanta13
: Besides, it was a {i}mutual{/i} breakup. Right?
lines.zh: : 再说，那是{i}双方{/i}都同意的分手。对吧？

lines.en: : Oh...yeah. Mutual.
lines.zh: : 哦……对。双方同意。

lines.en: : Futaba...thanks. You really didn’t have to do this.
lines.zh: : Futaba……谢谢。你真的不必这么做。

lines.en: scene springsanta14
: Oh, stop. We were friends {i}before{/i} you two started dating. We don’t need to {i}stop{/i} being friends just because you broke up.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，别这样。在你们俩开始交往{i}之前{/i}我们就是朋友了。不会因为你们分手，我们就得{i}停止{/i}做朋友。

lines.en: : Yeah, but still. It was probably awkward having to buy this for someone your roommate’s probably been ranting about nonstop.
lines.zh: : 是啦，不过还是。要给你室友大概一直在没完没了抱怨的人买礼物，应该挺尴尬的吧。

lines.en: : I mean, it could be worse. You could have published a book with all of my most intimate and personal secrets while not doing nearly enough to disguise the fact that the character is literally just {i}me.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我是说，还可能更糟呢。你大可以出一本书，把我最私密、最个人的秘密全写进去，还几乎不加掩饰，让人一眼就看出那个角色根本就是{i}我{/i}。

lines.en: : Well, I suppose that answers your question, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我想这回答了你的问题，Otoha。

lines.en: scene springsanta15
: Futaba, about that — I get that you’ve known Nodoka way longer than I have, but please don’t think she did any of that to {i}hurt{/i} you.
lines.zh: : Futaba，关于那件事——我知道你认识 Nodoka 的时间比我长得多，但请别以为她那么做是为了{i}伤害{/i}你。

lines.en: : Like, if you were around to hear the things she says about you when we’re alone-
lines.zh: : 比如说，要是你在场，听到我们独处时她是怎么说你的——

lines.en: : Let’s not talk about that tonight.
lines.zh: : 今晚就别聊这个了。

lines.en: scene springsanta16
: Merry Christmas, Otoha. Merry Christmas, Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 圣诞快乐，Otoha。圣诞快乐，Nodoka。

lines.en: : Here’s to another great year.
lines.zh: : 敬又一个美好的一年。

lines.en: : Futaba, is Sensei’s penis {i}ten{/i} inches? Or eleven? I’m having trouble picturing it at the moment.
lines.zh: : Futaba，Sensei 的鸡巴是{i}十{/i}英寸吗？还是十一英寸？我这会儿有点想象不出来。

lines.en: scene springsanta17
: {i}Why?{/i} Why do you do this?
lines.zh: : {i}为什么？{/i}你为什么要做这种事？

lines.en: : Simple. I’m making a timeline and I’m attempting to find out how much it’s grown. And Futaba has a great deal of experience with-
lines.zh: : 很简单。我在做一条时间线，想弄清楚它长了多少。而 Futaba 在这方面经验相当丰富——

lines.en: scene springsanta18
: Wait, Futaba. You forgot to answer my question.
lines.zh: : 等等，Futaba。你忘了回答我的问题。

lines.en: : {i}How are you this dumb?{/i} Aren’t you supposed to be some kind of...super genius? What the fuck was that?
lines.zh: : {i}你怎么能蠢成这样？{/i}你不是应该是什么……超级天才吗？那到底是什么鬼？

lines.en: scene black
: I’m just going to circle my original answer of ten and make a note to revisit it in the future. I’m sure I’ll have plenty of opportunities once Sensei returns to school.
lines.zh: : 我就先把原来的答案「十」圈起来，再记一笔以后复查。等 Sensei 回学校，我肯定会有大把机会。

lines.en: : Oh my fucking god...
lines.zh: : 我的天哪……

lines.en: scene springsanta19
: Wha...
scene springsanta20
: Are you frickin’ joshin’ me right now? Cause I ain’t normally a fighter, but I’m takin’ you down if this is some kinda prank, Sana.
lines.zh: : 你现在是在跟我开玩笑吧？因为我平时不打架，可要是这是某种恶作剧，我就把你放倒，Sana。

lines.en: : It’s not a prank...
lines.zh: : 不是恶作剧……

lines.en: : My mom got me a new one for Christmas since...she knows I like games and...I didn’t have the heart to tell her she bought me one a few years ago as well...
lines.zh: : 我妈妈圣诞节给我买了个新的，因为……她知道我喜欢游戏，而且……我不忍心告诉她，几年前她也给我买过一个……

lines.en: : So...since you like games and stuff too...I figured I could give {i}you{/i} the old one and...we could maybe, like...play together sometime?...
lines.zh: : 所以……既然你也喜欢游戏什么的……我想我可以把旧的给{i}你{/i}，然后……我们也许可以……哪天一起玩？……

lines.en: : Um...Miku?...
lines.zh: : 呃……Miku？……

lines.en: : Now, I ain’t sexually attracted to girls-
lines.zh: : 现在，我对女孩没有性方面的兴趣——

lines.en: scene springsanta21
: But I’m about ready to make the same damn move Rin made on you earlier, Sana.
lines.zh: : 可我差不多要对 Sana 使出 Rin 刚才对你使的那一招了，真是要命。

lines.en: : That...won’t be necessary?...
lines.zh: : 那……就不必了吧？……

lines.en: scene springsanta22
: Prob’ly not. But it ain’t like I got the best track record when it comes to kisses and Secret Santa. Plus, goin’ after you would sure make Makoto a lot happier than my last choice.
lines.zh: : 大概不必。不过说到接吻和神秘圣诞老人，我的战绩可算不上好看。再说，追你肯定比我上一个选择让 Makoto 高兴得多。

lines.en: : You’re really makin’ me rethink some stuff right now. Wow.
lines.zh: : 你现在真的让我开始重新想一些事了。哇。

lines.en: : That wasn’t...my intention...
lines.zh: : 那不是……我的本意……

lines.en: scene springsanta23
: Can I, like...{i}really{/i} have this?...
lines.zh: : 我，那个……{i}真的{/i}可以收下这个吗？……

lines.en: : Cause even if it’s used, that thing’s way above the spending limit, ain’t it? You could’ve sold it, gotten me some cheap stuff, then pocketed the rest. Why you bein’ so nice to me?
lines.zh: : 因为就算是用过的，那玩意儿也远超预算上限了吧？你本可以把它卖掉，给我买点便宜东西，剩下的揣进自己口袋。你为什么对我这么好？

lines.en: : Maybe I just...give special treatment to...people I can speak to at eye-level?...
lines.zh: : 也许我只是……会对……能平视着说话的人特殊照顾？……

lines.en: scene springsanta24
: Well...there ain’t many of us and...I guess we {i}do{/i} gotta stick together, but...{i}wow.{/i}
lines.zh: : 嗯……我们这种人不多，而且……我想我们{i}确实{/i}得互相照应，不过……{i}哇{/i}。

lines.en: : And I thought {i}Sensei's{/i} present was good.
lines.zh: : 我还以为{i}Sensei{/i}的礼物已经够好了呢。

lines.en: scene springsanta25
: I’m glad you like it...I worked extra hard on the bow since I don’t have the original box anymore.
lines.zh: : 我很高兴你喜欢……我特别用心地打了那个蝴蝶结，因为原来的盒子我已经没有了。

lines.en: : It’s gonna be a shame when it winds up in the trash twenty minutes from now.
lines.zh: : 等二十分钟后它被扔进垃圾桶，那可就可惜了。

lines.en: : Yeah, but at least it got to look like a present again...
lines.zh: : 是啊，不过至少它又像个礼物了……

lines.en: : Yeah...{i}wow.{/i}
scene springsanta26
: Ya know...you’ve come a long way, Sana. I’m real proud of ya.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……你已经走了很远了，Sana。我真为你骄傲。

lines.en: : Huh? What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 哈？你什么意思？

lines.en: : You’re like, way different than you were at the start of the school year. And I know talkin’ to people ain’t really been your strength since all that stuff went down way back when.
lines.zh: : 你跟开学时比，简直判若两人。我知道，自从很久以前那些事发生之后，跟人说话一直不是你的强项。

lines.en: : But you’re like a different person now. Ain’t sure if I’d call ya {i}outgoing{/i} yet, but I think you’re gettin’ there. And I’m happy to see you’re startin’ to fit in a little more.
lines.zh: : 可你现在就像变了个人。我还不确定能不能说你{i}外向{/i}了，但我觉得你正在往那个方向走。我很高兴看到你开始更融入一点了。

lines.en: scene springsanta27
: I’m not...the only one who’s changed, you know. You’re a lot different than...{i}you{/i} were at the start of the school year too.
lines.zh: : 我可不是……唯一变了的那个，你知道吧。你也跟开学时的{i}你{/i}大不一样了。

lines.en: : Like...I never would have imagined you...willingly wearing a dress to a Christmas party...
lines.zh: : 比如说……我从来没想过你会……自愿穿裙子来圣诞派对……

lines.en: scene springsanta28
: Yeah...to tell ya the truth, I ain’t sure I’m the biggest fan of wearin’ clothes like this. I’ve got a lot I still need to, like...figure out and stuff.
lines.zh: : 是啊……说实话，我也不确定自己有多喜欢穿这样的衣服。我还有很多事需要，呃……想清楚之类的。

lines.en: : But it ain’t like I {i}hate{/i} it, you know? I’ve just always felt more normal in...yeah, I’m sure ya get the point. You’ve seen how I normally look.
lines.zh: : 可我也{i}不讨厌{/i}它，你知道吗？我只是穿……的时候一直感觉更像自己，嗯，我敢肯定你懂我意思。你见过我平时的样子。

lines.en: : Mhm. But I think you look really pretty like this. And I like whatever it is that’s causing you to change as long as you’re still happy.
lines.zh: : 嗯。不过我觉得你这样看起来真的很漂亮。而且只要你依然开心，不管是什么让你在改变，我都喜欢。

lines.en: : Yeah...I like it too.
lines.zh: : 是啊……我也喜欢。

lines.en: : Maybe a little {i}too{/i} much.
lines.zh: : 也许是{i}太{/i}喜欢了一点。

lines.en: : Is it...something specific? Or...
lines.zh: : 是……有什么具体的原因吗？还是……

lines.en: scene springsanta29
: Yeah, but...I ain’t really allowed to talk about it. I’ve already gone and blabbed to a few too many people, so I’m on thin ice.
lines.zh: : 是有，不过……我真的不能说。我已经跟太多人说了，现在是如履薄冰。

lines.en: scene springsanta30
: Ah.
: Yeah...sorry for not bein’ able to tell you any more. It’s just-
lines.zh: : 是啊……抱歉没法再告诉你更多了。只是——

lines.en: : No, it’s okay.
lines.zh: : 不，没关系的。

lines.en: scene black
: I don’t need to know.
lines.zh: : 我不需要知道。

lines.en: scene springsanta31
: Not sure what I was thinking when I decided to bring this here.
lines.zh: : 我都不知道自己当初决定把这东西带来时是怎么想的。

lines.en: : Of course you wouldn’t show up....You {i}never{/i} show up anymore. You’ve stopped giving a shit about {i}all{/i} of us...
lines.zh: : 你当然不会来。……你{i}再也没{/i}出现过了。你已经不再在乎{i}我们任何人{/i}了……

lines.en: : But {i}why?...{/i}
lines.zh: : 可{i}为什么？……{/i}

lines.en: : {i}What happened?...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}发生了什么？……{/i}

lines.en: : Where did we go wrong?...
lines.zh: : 我们到底哪里走错了？……

lines.en: : How do we bring you back?...
lines.zh: : 我们要怎么把你带回来？……

lines.en: : But most importantly...
lines.zh: : 但最重要的是……

lines.en: scene springsanta32
: What the hell am I supposed to do with these stupid tickets now?!
lines.zh: : 那这些该死的票我现在该怎么办啊？！

lines.en: : Hello!
lines.zh: : 你好！

lines.en: scene springsanta33
: Ah!
scene springsanta34
: Oh...Yasu. Hello.
lines.zh: : 哦……Yasu。你好。

lines.en: : It appears that the darkness has begun to swallow you whole.
lines.zh: : 看来黑暗已经开始把你整个吞没了。

lines.en: : No, I’m just black.
lines.zh: : 不，我只是黑人。

lines.en: scene springsanta35
: We are all black on the inside — and only His light can save us.
lines.zh: : 我们内心都是黑的——只有祂的光才能拯救我们。

lines.en: : Girl, I don’t even know where to start with that one.
lines.zh: : 姑娘，我都不知道该从哪儿开始吐槽这句。

lines.en: : Sorrow clings to the air around you, circling your body and consuming you as you fall deeper and deeper into the depths of despair. But I know something that will cure you- temporary as it may be.
lines.zh: : 悲伤黏在你周围的空气里，绕着你的身体打转，在你一点点坠入绝望深渊时吞噬着你。不过我知道有样东西能治好你——哪怕只是暂时的。

lines.en: : I know you ain’t about to start preaching to me at a Christmas party, Yasu. Tonight ain’t the night.
lines.zh: : 我知道你总不至于要在圣诞派对上对我布道吧，Yasu。今晚不是时候。

lines.en: : Every night is the night when all nights belong to Him.
lines.zh: : 当所有的夜晚都属于祂，每一夜都是那个夜晚。

lines.en: scene springsanta36
: But He is asleep right now...and these worthless hands can not find the light on their own.
lines.zh: : 可祂现在睡着了……而这双无用的手无法自己找到光。

lines.en: : They couldn’t even spare the lamb they led astray.
lines.zh: : 它们连那只被引入歧途的羔羊都救不了。

lines.en: : Hey, question. The fuck you doing with a crab?
lines.zh: : 嘿，问个问题。你拿只螃蟹干嘛？

lines.en: scene springsanta37
: This is no crab.
lines.zh: : 这不是螃蟹。

lines.en: : Nah...that’s a crab, Yasu.
lines.zh: : 不……那就是只螃蟹，Yasu。

lines.en: : This is a gift.
lines.zh: : 这是礼物。

lines.en: scene springsanta38
: I know you ain’t about to give me a crab for Secret Santa.
lines.zh: : 我知道你总不至于要送我一只螃蟹当神秘圣诞老人礼物吧。

lines.en: : What is “Secret Santa?”
lines.zh: : 「神秘圣诞老人」是什么？

lines.en: : Yasu, what do you think we’re doing right now? Why do you think everyone is wandering around the room and giving each other presents? This ain’t your first rodeo. You should know this.
lines.zh: : Yasu，你觉得我们现在在干什么？你觉得为什么大家都在屋里走来走去地互送礼物？这又不是你第一次参加。你应该知道的。

lines.en: : Your darkness is all-consuming. It entrances me to the point where I am unable to focus on the happenings of the rest of the room, for I know that I must cleanse you.
lines.zh: : 你的黑暗吞噬一切。它让我着迷到无法把注意力放在房间里其他事上，因为我知道我必须净化你。

lines.en: scene springsanta39
: God damn. I really hope for your sake that you never leave this city.
lines.zh: : 天哪。我真为你着想，希望你永远别离开这座城市。

lines.en: : There is no reason to leave this city, for He can not exist outside of its area of effect. And without Him, I am even closer to {i}nothing{/i} than I was the day I was born.
lines.zh: : 没有理由离开这座城市，因为祂无法存在于它的作用范围之外。而没有祂，我比我出生那天更接近{i}虚无{/i}。

lines.en: : Yasu...just tell me what you want, okay? I don’t have the energy for this tonight.
lines.zh: : Yasu……直接告诉我你想要什么，好吗？我今晚没力气应付这个了。

lines.en: : I want to know why you’re sad.
lines.zh: : 我想知道你为什么难过。

lines.en: scene springsanta40
: For if I can not help, I can listen. And Touka says an ear is worth a thousand hands.
lines.zh: : 因为如果我帮不上忙，我还可以倾听。Touka 说过，一只耳朵抵得上一千双手。

lines.en: : I’m having a hard time picturing those words coming out of Touka’s mouth, but I think I get what you’re saying.
lines.zh: : 我很难想象这话会从 Touka 嘴里说出来，不过我想我懂你的意思。

lines.en: : I’m not gonna bother a teenage girl with my stupid problems, though. I’m just a little...temperamental right now.
lines.zh: : 不过我不会拿我那些蠢问题去烦一个十几岁的女孩。我只是现在有点……情绪化。

lines.en: scene springsanta41
: I understand...My blood {i}also{/i} curdles in the springtime.
lines.zh: : 我明白……我的血{i}也{/i}会在春天凝结。

lines.en: : I...don’t think you do.
lines.zh: : 我……不觉得你明白。

lines.en: : But the gist of it is this...
lines.zh: : 不过大致是这样的……

lines.en: scene springsanta42
: {i}There’s someone I want to see right now.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}现在有个人我很想见。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}And he feels further away than ever before.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}而他感觉比以往任何时候都更遥远。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You poor soul...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你这可怜的人……{/i}

lines.en: : {b}{i}I really do understand.{/i}{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}{i}我真的明白。{/i}{/b}
